description: Response-window helper table and independence from lifecycle state.

cases.derivation: Pure helper table, ResponseWindowPolicy{SetupBars:4, CountdownBars:12}: Eligible(kind, age) is true for 0<=age<=window. Setup 4 eligible / 5 expired; Countdown 12 / 13. age = decision bar index - anchor bar index (Setup-9 bar, or Countdown completion bar). Negative ages are not eligible.

Imperfect Setup 9 at 13, threshold 87. Slide lows are 103-i from 13; the bar before 17 has low equal to the threshold. Delayed perfection fires at 17 (age 4) whatever the age (pending lasts until perfected or replaced, D3). Helper: Eligible(setup,4)=True. A decision at 17 fills at the open of 18 (age 5). The Countdown keeps counting every bar (count = bar-12) through the expiry.

Counts 1..13 at 13..25, complete at 25. From 26 the closes repeat 82,81,80,79 (each equals the close four bars earlier): equality keeps both runs 0, so no recycle and no new Setup. Age = bar - 25: age 12 (bar 37) eligible, its fill at the open of 38 is outside the window; age 13 (bar 38) expired. The completed Countdown is NOT cleared by expiry: completed at 37 and 38.

Wick 5 on every bar from 13 blocks all counts after 14 (count 2). Bar 26 repeats c22 (equality) so the run stops at 21 (no recycle). The unfinished Countdown stays active, count 2, episode 13, at age 12 (bar 25), age 13 (bar 26) and age 25 (bar 38): the response window never cancels or recycles a Countdown, and no event is emitted by expiry. No window age is asked for an unfinished Countdown (it has no anchor); only its state is asserted.
